title: Apply v5 — panel round 3: hoodie = the denial, honest net math, time passes, clown-share prompt
music: Santigold - Disparate Youth (TikTok sound, starts at 'Don't look ahead')

sections.text: Time off, denied. Closing Saturday. Thirteen twenty-five an hour.
So you put that notification on a hoodie, and your friends call it unrealistic.
Your first store flops. Sixty dollars, gone. That's four and a half closing hours. Your second one flops too.
So the third time, you don't buy anything first. You post the mockup three nights in a row. The third one hits. Forty people ask. Fourteen pay. You print fourteen.
After costs, two hundred thirty-eight dollars. Minus the hundred and one you lost before, you're still up.
And the friend who said unrealistic? Wants one for free.
